description.en: The AppName of all live streams. An asterisk (\*) matches all AppNames.

description.zh: 直播流名，`*`表示匹配AppName下所有流。
description.en: The stream name. An asterisk (\*) matches all streams under the specified AppName.

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口删除直播封装配置，重新推流后才生效。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为300次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to delete a live stream encapsulation configuration. The change takes effect the next time you ingest the stream.

## QPS limits

You can call this operation up to 300 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-package-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name AppName --stream-name StreamName --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLivePackageConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName StreamName --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName AppName
